scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.db.yml --profile db up -d db
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.db.yml --profile db stop db
scripts.redis:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.redis.yml --profile redis up -d redis
scripts.redis:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.redis.yml --profile redis stop redis
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kb/shared test && pnpm --filter @kb/core test && pnpm --filter @kb/api test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
